mu = df['value'].mean()
sigma = df['value'].std(ddof=0)

    adj[row['borough']].append(row['neighbor'])

    if len(zs) == 0:

            I_perm = shuffled_dict[b] * L_perm
            I_perms[b].append(I_perm)
